body: Finished notice rides Op::Send with a new reply_to field (sent as reply_parameters.message_id, no allow_sending_without_reply) instead of a new Op variant or the deprecated reply_to_message_id; a reply to a deleted block is refused rather than sent loose.

Notice is produced by Registry::block_done the first time a block shows its final text with a message_id and thread_id; persisted Block.notified makes it once-only (marked at hand-out, not retried), instead of a separate persisted notice queue.
